name: olf-obligation-manager
description: Cowork-facing post-signature obligation and renewal management for an OLF lawyer maintaining a durable register for repeat clients. Picks up where the review-bot leaves off: from an EXECUTED engagement letter or commercial contract it extracts the living obligations — notice periods, renewals, termination rights, price adjustments, reporting duties, insurance requirements, data obligations, audit rights — into a store-agnostic register, computes each provision's diary date, and runs a compliance sweep that buckets what needs action (overdue / imminent / upcoming / watch). Surfaces an HTML dashboard console and posts a due-dates digest to the internal OLF team Slack channel, staying silent when nothing is due. Verified deadlines sync to an internal Google Calendar (idempotently), and a verification gate holds unconfirmed rows out of every alert. Internal reminders (Slack digest, internal calendar) may post; client-facing calendar invites and anything outbound to a client or counterparty stay draft-only and need per-item approval. Ships a recurrence roll-forward, a per-client report, and an extraction-accuracy eval harness.
